comment: Falls from heights, running drops off an edge (generated drop nav links) and knockback falls (game designer items 6 / 10 / 11a, 2026-11-03; docs/systems/stances-and-movement.md 'Falls and drops'). Read by FallRules::GetConfig (Source/CodexTactics/Public/Falls/FallRules.h) at game start; FFallConfig's defaults mirror these values (test CodexTactics.Falls.Rules.TuningFileMirrorsDefaults). Distances cm, speeds cm/s, times s. DEFAULTS PENDING the game designer's confirmation: the ladder-fall damage curve with one 3 m level free (safe 320 cm, 0.1 HP / cm, max 40, no lethal height), links for drops of 1.5-6.5 m with a gap of at most 2.5 m. The pathfinder's extra cost of a drop is in the nav areas (UNavArea_Drop / UNavArea_DropHurt: DefaultCost / FixedAreaEnteringCost, overridable in DefaultEngine.ini). Console: Codex.Fall.DropLinks 0 off / 1 per level JSON "drop_links" / 2 everywhere.
